sources.title: SBS Japanese
sources.ja: SBS 日本語《にほんご》 放送《ほうそう》
sources.en: Japanese-language radio from Australia's multicultural public broadcaster: news, interviews and features you can play or download.
sources.tip: Pick one short episode on a topic you know, listen once for gist, then again pausing to note new words.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened /language/japanese/ja/listen: page titled 日本語ラジオ＆ポッドキャスト, calls the broadcast SBS日本語放送; lists live broadcast times on SBS Radio 3 and dated episodes 12/11/2026 to 20/11/2026 with MP3 Download links. Also opened /language/japanese/ja/podcast/sbs-japanese: newest episode published 20/11/2026, MP3 links, no region limit stated, no paywall, optional login. No transcripts seen on the list page. Domestic public broadcaster serving Japanese speakers in Australia (not an outlet speaking for a foreign government). Not in podcasts.json.

sources.title: radiko
sources.en: Shared web player for Japanese commercial radio, with a past-week replay. It plays only inside Japan, so it is useful on a trip there.
sources.tip: While in Japan, try a morning talk show for ten minutes and write down three phrases you caught.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened radiko.jp: English notice says the service is available only in Japan and cannot be accessed from the current location. Describes タイムフリー (replay of the past week) and paid radiko Premium for nationwide stations; free tier covers local-area stations. One WebSearch showed 2026-dated press releases (Oct 2026) mentioning radiko. The station entries InterFM897, J-WAVE, FM Yokohama and Radio NIKKEI were removed because their own sites send live listening to radiko; this entry covers them. No Japanese name (Latin only), so no ja.

sources.title: JCBA Internet Simulcast Radio
sources.ja: JCBA インターネット サイマルラジオ
sources.en: Portal that streams Japan's local community FM stations, listed by region. It plays only inside Japan, so it is useful on a trip there.
sources.tip: On a trip, open the station for the town you are in and listen to its local news and event talk.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened the home page: run by the Japan Community Broadcasting Association; stations grouped by region (Hokkaido to Kyushu) with LISTEN links; only 2026 date is the copyright line, no dated news, so active left 'unknown'. Opened /faq/: says listening from overseas is restricted except for some programmes, and that it is free apart from data costs.
